field.label: Enable RPZ
field.help: Enable Response Policy Zone support. Each zone's file must exist at /usr/local/etc/namedb/primary/<name>.db before applying.

field.label: Break DNSSEC
field.help: Allow RPZ to rewrite DNSSEC-signed responses. Required when using NXDOMAIN or NODATA policy with DNSSEC-validating clients. Applies to the whole response-policy statement, not per zone.
